candidates.title: Best Paper Award
candidates.issuer: ECIR (29th European Conference on Information Retrieval)
candidates.description: Awarded at ECIR 2007 while he was a researcher at ISTI-CNR, Pisa (announced by CNR institutional news as "Best Paper Award alla 29th ECIR 2007 - premiato Fabrizio Silvestri Ricercatore Isti CNR").

candidates.title: Yahoo! Faculty Research and Engagement Program (FREP) award
candidates.description: Recipient of the 2011 Yahoo! Faculty Research and Engagement Program in the area "Computational Advertising, Machine Learning and Search & Web Mining", while a researcher at ISTI-CNR "A. Faedo", Pisa.

candidates.title: Test-of-Time Award
candidates.description: ECIR 2018 Test-of-Time Award recognizing a paper originally published at ECIR 2007 (per his official DIAG Sapienza faculty profile, which states he "holds the 'test-of-time' award at the ECIR 2018 conference for an article published in 2007").

notes: Verified via institutional sources: (a) CNR news item for the ECIR 2007 Best Paper Award; (b) ISTI-CNR and CNR news items for the 2011 Yahoo! FREP award (two institutional sources — high confidence); (c) DIAG Sapienza faculty page for the ECIR 2018 Test-of-Time Award (single institutional source — medium confidence). The DIAG Sapienza page further states that Prof. Silvestri "is the holder of three best paper awards and other international awards". Only one of these three best-paper awards (ECIR 2007) could be pinned down to a specific venue/year from a verifiable institutional source during this search; the other two best-paper awards and the unspecified "other international awards" are referenced on his official university bio but a human reviewer should chase them down (candidate venues to probe: SIGIR / CIKM / WSDM / HPCC / Euro-Par workshops, and any Meta/Facebook internal recognition from his FAIR tenure). Web-search rate limits prevented exhaustive follow-up queries in this session. Namesakes filtered out: Daniele Silvestri (musician), Charles Anthony Silvestri (poet/lyricist), Oreste/Cristian/Giuseppe/Graciela Silvestri, Simone Silvestri (University of Kentucky CS — different person), and various non-CS Fabrizios (Gifuni, Soccorsi, Calvi, Ruggeri). The Italian journalist/filmmaker namesake did not surface in the award-focused queries.
